title: 1971 Game of the Century: Nebraska 35, Oklahoma 31 in Norman
question: Who won the 1971 Game of the Century between Oklahoma and Nebraska?
answer: Nebraska won 35-31 on Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 25, 1971, at Owen Field in Norman. Jeff Kinney's 2-yard touchdown run with 1:38 left decided the matchup of No. 1 Nebraska and No. 2 Oklahoma.
summary: No. 1 Nebraska beat No. 2 Oklahoma 35-31 on Thanksgiving Day 1971 in Norman. Here's how the Game of the Century unfolded, from Rodgers' punt return to Kinney.
body: Few regular-season games have carried the weight of Thanksgiving Day 1971. Nebraska arrived in Norman at 10-0 and ranked No. 1. Oklahoma was 9-0 and ranked No. 2. ABC carried the game nationally, and the analyst in the booth was former Sooners coach Bud Wilkinson.

Nebraska struck first when Johnny Rodgers returned a punt 72 yards for a touchdown in the opening minutes. The Huskers pushed their lead to 14-3, but Jack Mildren and the Sooners' wishbone answered. Just before halftime, Mildren capped a quick 76-yard drive with a touchdown pass to Jon Harrison, and Oklahoma went into the break ahead 17-14.

The second half went back and forth. Kinney scored twice in the third quarter to put Nebraska up 28-17, and Mildren ran one in to cut it to 28-24. Oklahoma then recovered a Jerry Tagge fumble, and Mildren later found Harrison again for a touchdown that put the Sooners up 31-28 in the fourth quarter. Nebraska answered with the drive everyone remembers: 74 yards in 12 plays. Jeff Kinney carried on the final four snaps and scored from 2 yards out with 1:38 left. He finished with 174 rushing yards and four touchdowns.

The loss was Oklahoma's only one of the season. The Sooners went on to beat Auburn 40-22 in the Sugar Bowl, and Nebraska beat Alabama in the Orange Bowl for its second straight national title. The final AP poll showed just how strong the Big Eight was that year: Nebraska first, Oklahoma second and Colorado third. Rodgers' punt return still lives on through the Jet Award, which goes to college football's top return specialist.
